description: This Java source file defines the BigTextIntentService class, an Android IntentService that handles snooze and dismiss actions for a notification with BigTextStyle in a reminder app. It manages notification updates, including recreating notifications if the app process is killed, and provides actions for snoozing and dismissing reminders.

classes.name: BigTextIntentService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that handles snooze and dismiss actions for BigTextStyle notifications in a reminder app, managing notification behaviors and recreation.

methods.name: BigTextIntentService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with the name 'BigTextIntentService'.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles incoming intents for snooze or dismiss actions and performs corresponding behavior.

methods.name: handleActionDismiss
methods.description: Cancels the notification when the dismiss action is triggered.

methods.name: handleActionSnooze
methods.description: Recreates the BigText-style notification, sleeps for the snooze duration, and then reissues it.

methods.name: recreateBuilderWithBigTextStyle
methods.description: Rebuilds the notification with BigTextStyle details, including actions for snooze and dismiss, to restore the notification after process death.
